verified_rules: OS Terrain 50 is an open lower-resolution DTM for Great Britain
grid and contour products are distinct deliveries derived from the same source data
the grid has regular 50m post spacing and is supplied in 10km by 10km tiles
ASCII and GML are supplied together and the GML carries location grid spacing vertical reference and spatial-reference metadata
each height value is calculated from the centre of its pixel
the ASCII header origin is the north-west corner of the tile while rows run west to east
there are 200 pixels per row and each pixel is 50m by 50m
per-tile GEMINI XML metadata records product identity spatial representation and 10km tile reference
the product is fully resupplied annually each July
tile references quote the National Grid reference of the south-west corner of the tile
grid values cannot be substituted with contour or spot-height values without changing the measurement semantics
candidate elevation promotion requires the exact TQ29 archive header and addressed cell values
quality_gate: PASS for grid release and sampling semantics; BLOCKED for candidate-specific cell values
